tiles.title: Sign-ins over time: users vs service principals vs managed identities
Admin operations by app and action
Mass download / deletion / sharing per user
Cloud app activity from countries never used for sign-in
New apps, credentials and owners (app persistence)
Service principal sign-ins: new IPs and failures
Sensitive Graph endpoints by app (mail, files, directory, roles)
Directory enumeration bursts (many objects per caller)
Graph calls from IPs never seen in any sign-in (possible token replay)
AD logon failures by account and protocol
Composite identity & app risk per user
Risky sign-in followed by app consent or role change (within 24h)
On-prem recon account also signing in to the cloud from new places

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
Sign | where ResultType == "0" | summarize Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName)

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Step = iff(_endTime - _startTime > 3d, 6h, 1h);
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
let Spn = external_table('AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend SpName = coalesce(tostring(P.ServicePrincipalName), tostring(P.AppDisplayName)), SpAppId = tostring(P.AppId), Resource = tostring(P.ResourceDisplayName), Loc = tostring(P.Location)
| where isempty(_app) or SpName has _app or SpAppId has _app
| project TimeGenerated, SpName, SpAppId, IPAddress, ResultType, Resource, Loc;
let Mi = external_table('AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend SpName = coalesce(tostring(P.ServicePrincipalName), tostring(P.AppDisplayName)), Resource = tostring(P.ResourceDisplayName)
| where isempty(_app) or SpName has _app
| project TimeGenerated, SpName, IPAddress = tostring(P.IPAddress), ResultType, Resource;
union
 (Sign | project TimeGenerated, Type = Kind),
 (Spn | project TimeGenerated, Type = "Service principal"),
 (Mi | project TimeGenerated, Type = "Managed identity")
| summarize SignIns = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, Step), Type
| order by TimeGenerated asc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
Sign
| where ClientAppUsed !in~ ("Browser", "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients", "")
| summarize SignIns = count(), Success = countif(ResultType == "0"), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), UserList = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10) by ClientAppUsed, AppDisplayName
| extend Severity = case(Success > 0 and ClientAppUsed has_any ("IMAP", "POP", "SMTP", "Exchange ActiveSync", "Authenticated SMTP", "Other clients", "Exchange Web Services", "MAPI"), "1-High (legacy auth succeeded)", Success > 0, "2-Medium", "3-Low (blocked)")
| order by Severity asc, SignIns desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Cae = external_table('CloudAppEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend R = todynamic(tostring(P.RawEventData))
| extend User = tolower(coalesce(tostring(R.UserId), tostring(P.AccountId), tostring(P.AccountDisplayName))), App = tostring(P.Application), Country = tostring(P.CountryCode),
         Isp = tostring(P.ISP), AnonProxy = tostring(P.IsAnonymousProxy) in~ ("true", "1"), AdminOp = tostring(P.IsAdminOperation) in~ ("true", "1")
| where isempty(_user) or User =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or App has _app;
Cae
| where AnonProxy
| summarize Events = count(), Actions = make_set(ActionType, 10), Apps = make_set(App, 5), IPs = make_set(tostring(P.IPAddress), 10), Countries = make_set(Country, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by User
| extend Severity = iff(tostring(Actions) has_any ("Download", "Send", "Rule", "Consent", "Add", "Delete", "Update"), "1-High (sensitive actions)", "2-Medium")
| order by Severity asc, Events desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Cae = external_table('CloudAppEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend R = todynamic(tostring(P.RawEventData))
| extend User = tolower(coalesce(tostring(R.UserId), tostring(P.AccountId), tostring(P.AccountDisplayName))), App = tostring(P.Application), Country = tostring(P.CountryCode),
         Isp = tostring(P.ISP), AnonProxy = tostring(P.IsAnonymousProxy) in~ ("true", "1"), AdminOp = tostring(P.IsAdminOperation) in~ ("true", "1")
| where isempty(_user) or User =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or App has _app;
let Threshold = 100;
Cae
| extend Kind = case(ActionType has_any ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull"), "Download", ActionType has_any ("FileDeleted", "FileRecycled", "HardDelete", "SoftDelete", "MoveToDeletedItems"), "Delete",
                     ActionType has_any ("SharingSet", "AnonymousLinkCreated", "SharingInvitationCreated", "AddedToSecureLink"), "Share", "")
| where isnotempty(Kind)
| summarize Events = count(), Objects = dcount(tostring(P.ObjectName)), IPs = make_set(tostring(P.IPAddress), 5), Apps = make_set(App, 5) by User, Kind, Hour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend Severity = case(Events >= Threshold * 5, "1-High", Events >= Threshold, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Events desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Cae = external_table('CloudAppEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend R = todynamic(tostring(P.RawEventData))
| extend User = tolower(coalesce(tostring(R.UserId), tostring(P.AccountId), tostring(P.AccountDisplayName))), App = tostring(P.Application), Country = tostring(P.CountryCode),
         Isp = tostring(P.ISP), AnonProxy = tostring(P.IsAnonymousProxy) in~ ("true", "1"), AdminOp = tostring(P.IsAdminOperation) in~ ("true", "1")
| where isempty(_user) or User =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or App has _app;
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
let SignCountries = Sign | where ResultType == "0" and isnotempty(Location) | summarize Known = make_set(Location) by User = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
Cae
| where isnotempty(Country)
| summarize Events = count(), Actions = make_set(ActionType, 10), IPs = make_set(tostring(P.IPAddress), 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by User, Country
| join kind=inner SignCountries on User
| where not(set_has_element(Known, Country))
| extend Severity = iff(tostring(Actions) has_any ("Download", "Send", "Rule", "Consent", "Delete"), "1-High (possible token theft)", "2-Medium")
| project Severity, User, Country, KnownSignInCountries = Known, Events, Actions, IPs, LastSeen
| order by Severity asc, Events desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Aud = external_table('AuditLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend IB = todynamic(tostring(InitiatedBy)), TR = todynamic(tostring(TargetResources))
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(IB.app.displayName)), ActorIP = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.ipAddress), tostring(IB.app.ipAddress)),
         Target = coalesce(tostring(TR[0].displayName), tostring(TR[0].userPrincipalName)), TargetType = tostring(TR[0].type), Props = tostring(TR[0].modifiedProperties)
| where isempty(_user) or Actor =~ _user or Target =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or Target has _app or Actor has _app;
Aud
| where OperationName has_any ("Consent to application", "Add delegated permission grant", "Add app role assignment to service principal", "Add OAuth2PermissionGrant")
| extend HighRisk = Props has_any ("Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.Send", "MailboxSettings", "Files.ReadWrite.All", "Sites.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "RoleManagement.ReadWrite", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "full_access_as_user", "offline_access", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Application.ReadWrite.All")
| extend AdminConsent = Props has "IsAdminConsent" and Props has "True"
| extend Severity = case(HighRisk and AdminConsent, "1-Critical (admin consent, high-risk scopes)", HighRisk, "2-High (high-risk scopes)", "3-Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, OperationName, Actor, ActorIP, App = Target, HighRisk, AdminConsent, Props
| order by Severity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Spn = external_table('AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend SpName = coalesce(tostring(P.ServicePrincipalName), tostring(P.AppDisplayName)), SpAppId = tostring(P.AppId), Resource = tostring(P.ResourceDisplayName), Loc = tostring(P.Location)

let Base = external_table('AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _startTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| summarize by SpAppId = tostring(P.AppId), IPAddress;
Spn
| join kind=leftouter (Base | extend Known = true) on SpAppId, IPAddress
| summarize SignIns = count(), Failures = countif(ResultType != "0"), NewIPs = make_set_if(IPAddress, isnull(Known), 10), Resources = make_set(Resource, 5), Locations = make_set(Loc, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SpName, SpAppId
| extend NewIPCount = array_length(NewIPs)
| extend Severity = case(NewIPCount > 0 and Failures > 0, "1-High (new IP + failures)", NewIPCount > 0, "2-Medium (new IP)", Failures >= 10, "3-Medium (failures)", "4-Low")
| order by Severity asc, NewIPCount desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Aud = external_table('AuditLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend IB = todynamic(tostring(InitiatedBy)), TR = todynamic(tostring(TargetResources))
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(IB.app.displayName)), ActorIP = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.ipAddress), tostring(IB.app.ipAddress)),
         Target = coalesce(tostring(TR[0].displayName), tostring(TR[0].userPrincipalName)), TargetType = tostring(TR[0].type), Props = tostring(TR[0].modifiedProperties)
| where isempty(_user) or Actor =~ _user or Target =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or Target has _app or Actor has _app;
Aud
| where OperationName has_any ("Add member to role", "Add eligible member to role", "Add scoped member to role", "Add member to role in PIM completed")
| mv-apply MP = todynamic(Props) on (summarize Role = take_anyif(replace_string(tostring(MP.newValue), '"', ''), tostring(MP.displayName) == "Role.DisplayName"))
| extend Severity = iff(Props has_any ("Global Administrator", "Privileged Role Administrator", "Application Administrator", "Cloud Application Administrator", "Exchange Administrator", "Security Administrator"), "1-High (tier-0 role)", "2-Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, OperationName, Actor, ActorIP, Target, Role, Props
| order by Severity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Graph = external_table('MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend Caller = coalesce(tostring(P.AppId), ""), UserId = tostring(P.UserId), SpId = tostring(P.ServicePrincipalId), Uri = tolower(tostring(P.RequestUri)),
         Method = tostring(P.RequestMethod), Status = toint(P.ResponseStatusCode), Ip = tostring(P.IPAddress), Ua = tostring(P.UserAgent)
| where isempty(_app) or Caller has _app
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, UserId, SpId, Uri, Method, Status, Ip, Ua;
Graph
| extend Area = case(Uri has_any ("/messages", "/mailfolders", "/sendmail"), "Mail", Uri has_any ("/drive", "/drives", "/sites"), "Files", Uri has_any ("/directoryroles", "/rolemanagement", "/approleassignments"), "Roles",
                     Uri has_any ("/applications", "/serviceprincipals", "/oauth2permissiongrants"), "Apps", Uri has_any ("/users", "/groups", "/devices"), "Directory", Uri has "/security", "Security", "")
| where isnotempty(Area)
| summarize Requests = count(), Writes = countif(Method in~ ("POST", "PATCH", "PUT", "DELETE")), Users = dcount(UserId), IPs = make_set(Ip, 5), Agents = make_set(Ua, 3), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Caller, Area
| extend Severity = case(Area in ("Mail", "Roles", "Apps") and Writes > 0, "1-High (writes to sensitive area)", Area in ("Mail", "Files") and Requests >= 1000, "2-Medium (bulk read)", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Requests desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Graph = external_table('MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend Caller = coalesce(tostring(P.AppId), ""), UserId = tostring(P.UserId), SpId = tostring(P.ServicePrincipalId), Uri = tolower(tostring(P.RequestUri)),
         Method = tostring(P.RequestMethod), Status = toint(P.ResponseStatusCode), Ip = tostring(P.IPAddress), Ua = tostring(P.UserAgent)
| where isempty(_app) or Caller has _app
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, UserId, SpId, Uri, Method, Status, Ip, Ua;
let Threshold = 500;
Graph
| where Uri has_any ("/users", "/groups", "/serviceprincipals", "/applications", "/devices", "/directoryroles") and Method =~ "GET"
| summarize Requests = count(), Uris = dcount(Uri), IPs = make_set(Ip, 5), Agents = make_set(Ua, 3) by Caller, UserId, Hour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend Severity = case(Uris >= Threshold and tostring(Agents) has_any ("python", "powershell", "curl", "azurehound", "roadtools", "graphrunner", "go-http"), "1-High (tooling enumeration)", Uris >= Threshold, "2-Medium (bulk enumeration)", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Uris desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Graph = external_table('MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend Caller = coalesce(tostring(P.AppId), ""), UserId = tostring(P.UserId), SpId = tostring(P.ServicePrincipalId), Uri = tolower(tostring(P.RequestUri)),
         Method = tostring(P.RequestMethod), Status = toint(P.ResponseStatusCode), Ip = tostring(P.IPAddress), Ua = tostring(P.UserAgent)
| where isempty(_app) or Caller has _app
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, UserId, SpId, Uri, Method, Status, Ip, Ua;
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
let SignIps = Sign | where ResultType == "0" | summarize by IPAddress;
let Ids = external_table('IdentityInfo') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountObjectId | project UserId = tostring(AccountObjectId), AccountUPN;
Graph
| where isnotempty(UserId) and isnotempty(Ip)
| join kind=leftanti SignIps on $left.Ip == $right.IPAddress
| summarize Requests = count(), Uris = make_set(Uri, 5), Callers = make_set(Caller, 5), Agents = make_set(Ua, 3), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by UserId, Ip
| join kind=leftouter Ids on UserId
| extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(Ip).country)
| extend Severity = case(tostring(Uris) has_any ("/messages", "/mailfolders", "/drive", "/approleassignments", "/rolemanagement"), "1-High (sensitive data from unknown IP)", Requests >= 100, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| project Severity, User = coalesce(AccountUPN, UserId), Ip, Country, Requests, Callers, Uris, Agents, FirstSeen
| order by Severity asc, Requests desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('IdentityLogonEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_user) or AccountUpn =~ _user or AccountName =~ _user
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| summarize Failures = count(), Devices = make_set(DeviceName, 5), Targets = make_set(DestinationDeviceName, 5), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5), Reasons = make_set(FailureReason, 5) by AccountUpn, Protocol
| extend Severity = case(Failures >= 50, "1-High", Failures >= 10, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Failures desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('IdentityLogonEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize Logons = count() by Protocol, ActionType
| order by Logons desc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('IdentityQueryEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_user) or AccountUpn =~ _user or AccountName =~ _user
| summarize Queries = count(), Types = make_set(QueryType, 10), Targets = dcount(QueryTarget), SampleTargets = make_set(QueryTarget, 10), Devices = make_set(DeviceName, 5) by AccountUpn, Protocol, ActionType
| extend Severity = case(Targets >= 100 or tostring(Types) has_any ("AllUsers", "AllGroups", "Admin", "AllComputers", "Spn"), "1-High (broad enumeration)", Targets >= 20, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Targets desc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('IdentityDirectoryEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_user) or AccountUpn =~ _user or TargetAccountUpn =~ _user
| extend AF = tostring(AdditionalFields)
| where ActionType has_any ("Group Membership changed", "Account Password changed", "Account Password Never Expires changed", "Account Disabled changed", "Account Constrained Delegation", "SID-History", "Account Supported Encryption Types changed", "Directory Services replication")
| extend Severity = case(AF has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Administrators", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators") or ActionType has_any ("SID-History", "replication", "Delegation"), "1-High (tier-0)", ActionType has "Password Never Expires", "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, ActionType, Actor = AccountUpn, Target = coalesce(TargetAccountUpn, TargetAccountDisplayName), DeviceName, AF
| order by Severity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Aud = external_table('AuditLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend IB = todynamic(tostring(InitiatedBy)), TR = todynamic(tostring(TargetResources))
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(IB.app.displayName)), ActorIP = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.ipAddress), tostring(IB.app.ipAddress)),
         Target = coalesce(tostring(TR[0].displayName), tostring(TR[0].userPrincipalName)), TargetType = tostring(TR[0].type), Props = tostring(TR[0].modifiedProperties)
| where isempty(_user) or Actor =~ _user or Target =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or Target has _app or Actor has _app;
let RiskEv = external_table('AADUserRiskEvents') | where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 1d) .. _endTime)
| project RiskTime = TimeGenerated, User = tolower(UserPrincipalName), RiskEventType, RiskLevel, RiskIp = IpAddress;
Aud
| where OperationName has_any ("Consent to application", "member to role", "Add service principal credentials", "Add owner to application", "Update user", "Reset password", "Register security info", "User registered security info")
| extend User = tolower(Actor)
| join kind=inner RiskEv on User
| where TimeGenerated between (RiskTime .. (RiskTime + 24h))
| extend Severity = case(OperationName has_any ("Consent", "role", "credentials", "owner"), "1-Critical", OperationName has_any ("security info", "Reset password"), "2-High (MFA / password change after risk)", "3-Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, User, RiskEventType, RiskLevel, RiskTime, RiskIp, OperationName, Target, ActorIP
| order by Severity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
let Recon = external_table('IdentityQueryEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize Targets = dcount(QueryTarget), QueryTypes = make_set(QueryType, 5) by User = tolower(AccountUpn) | where Targets >= 20;
let Base = external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 14d) .. _startTime) | where ResultType == "0" | summarize Known = make_set(Location) by User = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
Sign
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize Countries = make_set(Location, 10), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5) by User = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner Recon on User
| join kind=leftouter Base on User
| extend NewCountries = set_difference(Countries, coalesce(Known, dynamic([])))
| extend Severity = iff(array_length(NewCountries) > 0, "1-High (recon + new country)", "2-Medium (recon + cloud activity)")
| project Severity, User, Targets, QueryTypes, NewCountries, Countries, IPs, Apps
| order by Severity asc, Targets desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Sign = union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Interactive"),
 (external_table('AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
   | where isempty(_app) or AppDisplayName has _app
   | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, Kind = "Non-interactive");
let Cae = external_table('CloudAppEvents')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend P = pack_all()
| extend R = todynamic(tostring(P.RawEventData))
| extend User = tolower(coalesce(tostring(R.UserId), tostring(P.AccountId), tostring(P.AccountDisplayName))), App = tostring(P.Application), Country = tostring(P.CountryCode),
         Isp = tostring(P.ISP), AnonProxy = tostring(P.IsAnonymousProxy) in~ ("true", "1"), AdminOp = tostring(P.IsAdminOperation) in~ ("true", "1")
| where isempty(_user) or User =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or App has _app;
let Aud = external_table('AuditLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend IB = todynamic(tostring(InitiatedBy)), TR = todynamic(tostring(TargetResources))
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(IB.app.displayName)), ActorIP = coalesce(tostring(IB.user.ipAddress), tostring(IB.app.ipAddress)),
         Target = coalesce(tostring(TR[0].displayName), tostring(TR[0].userPrincipalName)), TargetType = tostring(TR[0].type), Props = tostring(TR[0].modifiedProperties)
| where isempty(_user) or Actor =~ _user or Target =~ _user
| where isempty(_app) or Target has _app or Actor has _app;
let U = tolower(_user);
union
 (Sign | where isnotempty(U) | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("SignIn ", Kind), Activity = AppDisplayName, Result = ResultType, IP = IPAddress, Detail = Location),
 (Cae | where isnotempty(U) | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CloudApp ", App), Activity = ActionType, Result = "", IP = tostring(P.IPAddress), Detail = Country),
 (Aud | where isnotempty(U) | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EntraAudit", Activity = OperationName, Result = Result, IP = ActorIP, Detail = Target),
 (external_table('AADUserRiskEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | where isnotempty(U) and UserPrincipalName =~ U
   | project TimeGenerated, Source = "RiskDetection", Activity = RiskEventType, Result = RiskLevel, IP = IpAddress, Detail = DetectionTimingType),
 (external_table('IdentityLogonEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | where isnotempty(U) and AccountUpn =~ U
   | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AD logon", Activity = strcat(ActionType, " ", Protocol), Result = FailureReason, IP = IPAddress, Detail = DestinationDeviceName),
 (external_table('IdentityDirectoryEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | where isnotempty(U) and (AccountUpn =~ U or TargetAccountUpn =~ U)
   | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AD change", Activity = ActionType, Result = "", IP = IPAddress, Detail = tostring(AdditionalFields))
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
